class.name: JRPGFormulaBattler
class.brief_description: The user or target of a damage formula.
class.description: A read-only view of a battler for [JRPGFormula]. A formula reads its values as properties ([code]a.atk[/code], [code]b.def[/code]...) and can call [method is_state_affected] and [method is_actor]. Battle code fills the values before evaluating a formula.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns the value [param name], or 0 if it was never set.

method.name: is_actor
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the battler is an actor rather than an enemy.

method.name: is_state_affected
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the battler has state [param state_id].

method.name: set_actor
method.description: Sets whether the battler is an actor.

method.name: set_states
method.description: Sets the battler's current state IDs.

method.name: set_value
method.description: Sets the value [param name], one of [code]atk[/code], [code]def[/code], [code]mat[/code], [code]mdf[/code], [code]agi[/code], [code]luk[/code], [code]mhp[/code], [code]mmp[/code], [code]hp[/code], [code]mp[/code], [code]tp[/code] and [code]level[/code].
